content:
Track: SQL Foundations
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: SQL Data Manipulation (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
    - Lesson 4: Joins and Join Conditions
    - Lesson 5: Working with Complex Queries (Subqueries, Unions, Intersects)
    - Lesson 6: Aggregate Functions
    - Lesson 7: Filtering Data with WHERE Clause
    - Lesson 8: Ordering Results with ORDER BY Clause
    - Lesson 9: Handling NULL Values and Error Conditions
    - Lesson 10: Aggregations and GROUP BY Clauses

   Track: Data Cleaning with Pandas
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Pandas Library
   - Lesson 2: Reading and Writing Data with Pandas
   - Lesson 3: Basic Data Selection and Indexing
   - Lesson 4: Handling Missing Values
   - Lesson 5: Merging and Concatenating DataFrames
   - Lesson 6: Data Grouping and Aggregation with Pandas
   - Lesson 7: Reshaping Data
   - Lesson 8: Cleaning and Transforming Data (Renaming, Changing Data Types)
   - Lesson 9: Handling Duplicates in DataFrames
   - Lesson 10: Working with Timestamps and Datetime Data

   Track: Intermediate SQL
   - Lesson 1: Advanced Joins (LEFT OUTER JOIN, RIGHT OUTER JOIN)
   - Lesson 2: Using Views and Aliasing Columns in SQL
   - Lesson 3: Complex Queries with Subqueries and Nested SELECT Statements
   - Lesson 4: Data Transformations with SQL Functions (CASE WHEN, COALESCE)
   - Lesson 5: Window Functions (ROW_NUMBER(), RANK())
   - Lesson 6: Using Stored Procedures and User-Defined Functions
   - Lesson 7: Advanced Data Filtering with SQL (LIKE, BETWEEN)
   - Lesson 8: Working with Multiple Tables using Transactions and Concurrency Control
   - Lesson 9: Security Considerations in SQL (Privileges, Access Control)
   - Lesson 10: Performance Optimization Techniques in SQL

   Track: Data Visualization with Python (Matplotlib)
   - Lesson 1: Intro to Matplotlib and Line Charts
   - Lesson 2: Creating Bar Charts and Histograms
   - Lesson 3: Scatter Plots and Box Plots
   - Lesson 4: Customizing Chart Appearance
   - Lesson 5: Working with Multiple Subplots
   - Lesson 6: Advanced Line Charts (Logarithmic, Semi-logarithmic)
   - Lesson 7: Area and Fill Between Plots
   - Lesson 8: Heatmaps and Contour Plots
   - Lesson 9: Geographic Mapping with Matplotlib
   - Lesson 10: Creating Animated Plots

   Track: Data Visualization with Python (Seaborn)
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Seaborn Library
   - Lesson 2: Creating Stylish Line Charts and Regression Plots
   - Lesson 3: Bar Plots and Count Plots
   - Lesson 4: Swarm, Box, and Violin Plots
   - Lesson 5: Heatmaps and Clustermaps
   - Lesson 6: Scatter Plot Matrix (Pairplot)
   - Lesson 7: Facet Grids and Multi-dimensional Visualizations
   - Lesson 8: Interactive Plots with Seaborn
   - Lesson 9: Customizing Styles, Colors, and Markers
   - Lesson 10: Advanced Visualization Techniques (KDE Plots, Contour Plots)
